title: Couldn't create new InterfaceControl
author: vndnua
body_snippet: There is a problem with connections that use an SSH tunnel. When I try to connect, I get the following error: The error occurs with connections using different protocols (I tested VNC, SSH, HTTP, and WinBox). This error started occurring recently. This issue does not occur in version mRemoteNG-nightly-20261006-v1.84.0-a684a59-x64.zip. Version 1.84.0 (Release 3734)...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thank you. The thread numbers in your log were what gave it away: the tunnel's PuTTY lines ran on the UI thread, and the failing control was built on a background thread right after the tunnel came up.

Cause, found in the build you named as good versus the current one: a change on October 7 (power-aware background work, #210) subscribes to a Windows power notification while the program is still starting, before any window exists. notes: fix shipped cc0f13cee (plain SyncContext from early SystemEvents subscription); [#216-diag] kept; awaiting reporter tunnel test
